title: Dimension at a point cut out by a local regular sequence
statement: For k a field and P=k[x_1,...,x_n], let I⊆P and q⊆P/I be prime. If I P_p is generated by an e-term regular sequence in P_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], where p is the inverse image of q, then e≤n and the local topological dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] of Spec(P/I) at q is n-e.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC, (5) implies (2), with Tags 00KW and 00P2

proof.text: Identify P_p / I P_p with S_q via IsLocalization.instQuotientIdealAlgebraMapSubmonoidMapRingHomAlgebraMap, q.map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective, and IsLocalization.algEquiv.

Apply ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular to List.ofFn h (the iterated dimension-drop lemma). Its ideal is I P_p by hgen. Identify the local dimensions with the heights d of q and d' of p. Thus d+e=d'.
Use the existing polynomial-quotient dimension-at-point identity: d≤d'≤n and dim_q Spec S=n-d'+d. Substitute d+e=d' to get e≤n and dim_q Spec S=n-e.

lean.statement:
theorem regularSequence_dimensionAtPoint
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))
    (q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I)) (hq : q.IsPrime)
    (e : ℕ) (h : Fin e → Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) (List.ofFn h))
    (hgen : Ideal.map
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range h)) :
    e ≤ n ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt
      (⟨q, hq⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I)) =
      ((n - e : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
